name: Lease IT Public Company Limited
summary: Lease IT Public Company Limited provides financial services to small and medium enterprises in Thailand. It offers leasing, factoring, hire purchase, bid bond and e-bidding, project backup financing, trade finance, letters of credit, and supplier finance programs, as well as other loans. The company also provides data information and credit analysis services, as well as credit project management, including contract document, debt follow-up, and other services related to the credit process. Lease IT Public Company Limited was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
